entries.back_en: We Wyndians do not fear height. On the contrary, we love high places.
I'm not afraid of height!
Ah, Princess Elina! And Princess [04]! Both are so beautiful! What would I do if both professed love for me? How could I choose between them!?
Sorry, but ordina ários... Princess [04]!?
Ordinary citizens cannot... Huh? Princess [04]!
It... It's Princess [04]!
Princess [04]! We didn't know you had returned!
Does this mean Princess Elina isn't coming back?
I didn't know what to think when I received word from Ludia that you'd been captured.
What was I to think? My daughter goes out in search of her missing sister, only to be caught trespassing in enemy land... How did this happen?
I beg your forgiveness, Majesty. It's all my fault. If it weren't for me...
As you surely discovered, our neighbor and supposed ally Ludia is more worried about their relations with the Empire than helping me search for my daughter.
So, what do you intend to do now? Sooner or later, the Ludians will surely discover you are here. Naturally, we'll do everything we can to protect you...
I see... But... Even though I am king of Wyndia, I have no control over the dragon... You know that.
Hmm... I see... Very well. Go to the woods east of here. There you'll find the Oracle of Wind, a priestess who serves the Wind Dragon.
I shall inform her of your coming. Rest tonight--you can begin your journey in the morning.
The King is in an extremely delicate position... On one hand, he must protect his daughter, Princess [04], and on the other maintain our relations with Ludia.
I pity the poor King... Although he worries about Princess Elina more than anyone, he doesn't discuss the matter with anyone in public. It hurts my heart to see him...
The [09] is an ancient sacred relic, needed to enter the Tower of Wind, which is sacred to the Wind Dragon. It is kept in a safe place beneath the Castle.
We have reports that Ludian troops were seen near the Castle. You must hurry, before they find out you are here!
The last time the Oracle came to the Castle was when Princess [04] was born.
They say the only way to see the Wind Dragon up close is to go even higher than the Tower of Wind, to the north. But how could anyone do that?
Princess Elina is engaged to marry the Prince of Ludia... Princess [04] is next in line to the throne... What to choose--a love that is wrong, or a love that cannot be?
Wait... If Princess [04] and I were united, that means one day I'll be King of Wyndia... Will I handle the responsibility?
entries.note: 'fomos unidos' is past tense; should be future subjunctive 'formos unidos' for 'if...are joined'.

entries.back_en: If I marry Princess Elina, that means the entire country of Ludia will be after us... Will I be able to protect her from them?
Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? I understand now why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
Hmm... The other half of the First Emperor, you say? I understand now why both Ludia and the Empire were looking for you! You carry a heavy burden... I wish you the best of luck.
[04]... There's little I can do for you now. You've grown much, my daughter. You're strong enough to fight your own battles now. I'm very proud of you!
I know what His Majesty the King said, but I also know that in his heart he still worries about you, Princess. Watch yourself, and return home soon!
Princess Elina still hasn't returned... I only pray nothing happens to Princess [04]...!
The King seems so lonely lately... I think he misses dining with his daughters.
The King seems so lonely lately... I think he misses dining with his daughters.
If I marry Princess [04], all of this... The town, the people... It'll be mine! Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha ha!
Why, Princess [04]! For a moment I almost mistook you for your sister. You've grown much more like her in recent weeks--more confident, more mature. If only she were here to see!
Ha ha... Bwah ha ha ha! Look at the people down there! They look like ants! Insects! Bwah ha ha ha ha!
P'ung Ryong, the Wind Dragon, is unusual among his kind in still interacting with mortals and speaking to them from time to time.
Those dragons are strange creatures, aren't they? I mean, look at the Wind Dragon--how can something so big fly like that?
Maybe those Ludians have finally given up... We haven't seen any around here for a while.
